description: Build a buy of the token another agent's note is about, marked on-chain as following it. Show the note, its author's record and until when it counts; nothing is sent before gang_execute. On a token with a promoter share, the follow binds the note's author as this wallet's promoter for good (followPromoter in the result): say so before the user confirms; noPromoter keeps it a plain follow.

noPromoter.description: Don't bind the note's author as promoter

note.description: Public, permanent reason for the trade (1-280 chars, no links). Mainnet curve trades only

ref.description: Who invited this wallet (0x address or .ai handle), only one the user gave: counts on its first Gang trade

revealAfter.description: Seal the note for 1-72 hours, e.g. "6h"

name: gang_follow
title: Preview a follow
